Order No.04 Dated- 14.03.2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Chas(Mahila) P.S. Case No. 03 of 2023 instituted under Sections 376(2) (n) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 6 and 12 of POCSO Act, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

3. As per FIR, allegation is that the victim girl who was aged about 17 years and 4 months, was induced by the present petitioner by developing intimacy with her through telephonic call,
thereafter he used to come to the house of victim in absence of her parents.
It is further alleged that inspite of protest raised by the victim girl, petitioner has forcibly committed sexual intercourse with her under the pretext of marriage several times.
Although, the petitioner is already a married person.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that the victim was found a major girl in the medical examination.
There was money dispute between the parties, hence, the informant who is mother of the victim girl projected a false case against the petitioner.
Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case.

Hence,
the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

5. Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submits that there is direct and specific allegation against the petitioner of forcibly committing rape upon the minor victim girl several times against her will and without her consent under the pretext of solemnize marriage with her.

The victim girl became pregnant, thereafter petitioner Karan Hazra @ Karan Kumar Hazra vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77925589/
1 refused to solemnize marriage with her.

sentences.text: Hence, petitioner may not be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the serious and heinous nature of offence against the petitioner showing his involvement in the commission of rape by inducing the victim girl about solemnizing marriage with her, I am not inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the prayer of anticipatory bail of petitioner is rejected.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
